name: Umfassender Kalender deutscher Feiertage 1991-2029 (öffentlich · katholisch · schulisch — viersprachig)
title: Umfassender Kalender deutscher Feiertage 1991-2029 (öffentlich · katholisch · schulisch — viersprachig)
description: Comprehensive catalog of German public, catholic, and school holidays from 1991 (the first full year after reunification) through 2029 (limit of currently-published school-holiday schedules). At the national level, only the `public` category is populated; catholic and school holidays are defined per Bundesland and are covered by the companion per-Land datasets. Names are provided in all four languages supported by vacanza/holidays for Germany: German (de, native), American English (en_US), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk).

meta.title: Umfassender Kalender deutscher Feiertage 1991-2029 (öffentlich · katholisch · schulisch — viersprachig) - Kostenloser Download
meta.description: Comprehensive catalog of German public, catholic, and school holidays from 1991 (the first full year after reunification) through 2029 (limit of currently-published school-holiday schedules). At the national level, only the `public` category is populated; catholic and school holidays are defined per Bundesland and are covered by the companion per-Land datasets. Names are provided in all four languages supported by vacanza/holidays for Germany: German (de, native), American English (en_US), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk). Enthält 355 Datensätze. Download in Excel, CSV, PDF.
